college_name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
campus_notes: Compiled 2026-09-14 from Carolina Housing's official residence-hall and room-type pages. UNC publishes an average room size on most hall pages and a measured floor plan on each room-type page, but states plainly that "all room dimensions are approximate and may vary from room to room" and that it cannot give exact measurements for every space, so hall-page averages are recorded as high confidence and room-type plans applied to halls that do not publish their own are recorded as medium. Suite and apartment units are modeled per bedroom so occupant counts and layouts match cleanly. Undergraduate beds are Twin XL (80" x 36"); rooms can be lofted.
